# Software requirements

```{r lib, message=FALSE,warning=FALSE}
library(blockForest)
library(tidyverse)
library(caret)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
```

# 2. BlockForest survival prediction

## Define script parameters 

```{r}
blocks_selected <- c("IMC") #Select which data types to use
add_surv_time <- FALSE #Add survival time in training
favor_clinical <- 1 #Favor specific block in BlockForest - 1 is CLIN (default; 0 would not favor)

run_name = "BF_IMC_Tumor.rds" #Name of output file
## Afterwards you can run all chunks directly (see default settings)
```

## Load and select data

```{r}
metadata_selected <- readRDS("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/key_features_processed.rds")
```

```{r}
# Select colnames based on prefix
selected <- list()
for(i in blocks_selected){
  selected[[i]] <- colnames(metadata_selected)[str_detect(colnames(metadata_selected),i)]
}
selected <- unname(unlist(selected))
```

```{r}
# Filter for complete cases (all data available)
meta <- metadata_selected %>% select(PID, status_OS, OS_months, all_of(selected)) %>% filter(complete.cases(.))

str(meta)
```

## Split survival and test

```{r}
# Select Y and X for blockforest
y <- meta %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% select(OS_months, status_OS)

x <- meta %>% column_to_rownames("PID") %>% select(-OS_months, -status_OS)

# Add surv time as test 
if(add_surv_time){
  x$CLIN_OS_months <- y$OS_months
}
```

## Folds

```{r}
# Create train/test splits considering similar censoring rates
set.seed(22)
folds <- createDataPartition(y$status_OS, p = 0.75, times = 5)
```

## Define blocks 

```{r}
block <- list()

# Define the block priorities
priorities <- c("CLIN", "IMC", "DNA", "META")
block_position <- 1

# Loop through priorities
for (keyword in priorities) {
  cols <- which(grepl(keyword, colnames(x)))
  if (length(cols) > 0) {
    block[[block_position]] <- cols
    block_position <- block_position + 1 # Increment if block was added
  }
}

# Display the block list
print(block)
```

## Perform BlockForest

### 5fold CV (Outer)

#### Define function 

```{r}
# Create a function for 5 fold outer cross-validation
cross_validate_blockforest <- function(x, y, folds, block, favor_clinical) {
  results <- vector("list", length(folds))
  
  for (i in seq_along(folds)) {
    
    print(paste("CV iteration:", i))
    
    # Split the data into training and test sets
    x_train <- x[folds[[i]],]
    x_test <- x[-folds[[i]],]

    y_train <- y[folds[[i]],]
    y_test <- y[-folds[[i]],]
    
    # Train the blockForest model
    blockforobj <- blockfor(X = x_train, 
                            y = as.matrix(y_train), 
                            blocks = block,
                            splitrule = "extratrees", 
                            block.method = "BlockForest",
                            num.trees = 2000,
                            nsets = 300, 
                            num.trees.pre = 1500,
                            always.select.block = favor_clinical,
                            num.threads = 30,
                            importance = "permutation")
    
    # Make predictions on the test data
    predres <- predict(blockforobj$forest, data = x_test)
    
    # Store the results for evaluation, e.g., store predicted survival functions
    results[[i]] <- list(predictions = predres,
                         actual_test = x_test,
                         actual_surv = y_test, 
                         variable_importance = blockforobj$forest$variable.importance)
    
    gc()
  }
  
  return(results)
}
```

## RUN and save results

```{r}
# Run cross-validation
set.seed(22)
cv_results <- cross_validate_blockforest(x, y, folds, block, favor_clinical)

# Save results
saveRDS(cv_results, paste0("/mnt/central_nas/rcc_volume/RCC/survival_pred/BlockForest/models/", run_name))
```
